object.name: evi_svf_eq_coeffs
object.digest: Coefficients calculator for twopole shelving filters
object.description: Coefficients calculator intended for Max schedular rate (in <o>gen</o> no tilde) for two evieve twopole SVF LTO filters. Used in many of the evieve reverb abstractions.

inlets.digest: Dummy inlet to feed @param values in. Does nothing else.

outlets.name: a1_1
outlets.digest: a1 coefficient for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: a2_1
outlets.digest: a2 coefficient for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: a3_1
outlets.digest: a3 coefficient for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: m0_1
outlets.digest: m0 mixing gain for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: m1_1
outlets.digest: m1 mixing gain for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: m2_1
outlets.digest: m2 mixing gain for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: a1_2
outlets.digest: a1 coefficient for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: a2_2
outlets.digest: a2 coefficient for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: a3_2
outlets.digest: a3 coefficient for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: m0_2
outlets.digest: m0 mixing gain for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: m1_2
outlets.digest: m2 mixing gain for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

outlets.name: m2_2
outlets.digest: m2 mixing gain for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

attributes.name: HOST_SR
attributes.description: The real audio samplerate (not the samplerate of a gen no tilde object) must be passed in here for the coefficients calculations to work correctly.

attributes.name: cutoff1
attributes.description: Cutoff frequency in Hz for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

attributes.name: cutoff2
attributes.description: Cutoff frequency in Hz for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

attributes.name: filter1
attributes.description: Select filter type for 1st SVF LTO filter section. 0=bypass, 1=bell, 2=lowshelf (default), 3=highshelf.

attributes.name: filter2
attributes.description: Select filter type for 2nd SVF LTO filter section. 0=bypass, 1=bell, 2=lowshelf, 3=highshelf (default).

attributes.name: gain1
attributes.description: Gain in dB for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

attributes.name: gain2
attributes.description: Gain in dB for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.

attributes.name: resonance1
attributes.description: Resonance (Q) for 1st SVF LTO filter section.

attributes.name: resonance2
attributes.description: Resonance (Q) for 2nd SVF LTO filter section.
